summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Democracy Ranking Panel feature. All major functionality working perfectly with excellent visual design and seamless integration.

design_issues.issue: Boundary condition: score 0.5 appears in Medium-Low (0.25-0.5) instead of Medium-High (0.5-0.75)
design_issues.note: Very minor edge case - filter logic uses >= min && < max

passed_tests: Ranking panel displays on left side with proper positioning
Shows all 179 countries with democracy rankings
Sort filter 'Highest First' correctly shows Sweden, Denmark at top
Sort filter 'Lowest First' correctly shows Eritrea at top
Category filter 'All Countries' shows all 179 countries
Category filter 'High (0.75-1.0)' shows 71 high democracy countries
Category filter 'Low (0-0.25)' shows 33 low democracy countries
Clicking countries in ranking opens side panel correctly
Side panel displays Liberal Democracy Index badge with value and progress bar
News articles load and display properly in side panel
Ranking shows country names, progress bars, and score badges
Color-coded ranking numbers (green for high, red for low democracy)
Visual elements (progress bars, badges, colors) working correctly
Panel closes properly with Escape key
Responsive design and layout working well
Integration between ranking panel and country panel seamless
action_item_for_main_agent: Optional minor fix: Adjust Medium-Low filter boundary condition to exclude score 0.5 (should be >= 0.25 && < 0.5). Currently 0.5 appears in Medium-Low instead of Medium-High category.
